Extensions.File: # ============================================================================= # Yaro - puts the Yaro wallpaper on the desktop of the signed-in user. # Runs from FirstLogon.ps1 and once for every new user (RunOnce). # The image: C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Yaro\yaro-wallpaper.png # ============================================================================= $p = 'C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Yaro\yaro-wallpaper.png' if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { return } Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name WallpaperStyle -Value '10' # Fill Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name TileWallpaper -Value '0' Add-Type -Namespace Yaro -Name Desktop -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int SystemParametersInfo(int uAction, int uParam, string lpvParam, int fuWinIni);' [void][Yaro.Desktop]::SystemParametersInfo(0x14, 0, $p, 3) # SPI_SETDESKWALLPAPER, save + notify
